# <a id="_Toc203750149"></a>Access Control Policy and Procedures for Azure

This document is an extension of the SISW Access Control Policy, and defines access control procedures for Azure\.

##### Policy Tag

[Siemens Industry Software \(SISW\) SaaS Access Control Policy\.pdf](#_References)

##### Scope

- Microsoft Azure only \(i\.e\. not AWS\)
- Definition of groups, roles, and permissions sets
- Detailed procedures for adding groups and members to a group
- Definition of review procedure

## <a id="_Toc203750150"></a>Principles

We follow the least\-privilege principle\. At the same time we acknowledge the working phase of the project and its changing dimensions\.

The project shall use Privileged Identity Management \(PIM\) functions to reduce persistent access to Azure resources

![](data:image/png;base64,)

__IMPORTANT__

Human actors are __eligible__ to activate their Entra PIM\-Enabled Group Membership\.

Entra PIM\-Enabled Groups have __active__ roles on Azure resources\.

*It is possible to do the same thing in exactly the opposite way\! But it causes more difficulties for the user\.*

For the initial period of the project, groups and SP’s will be assigned built\-in roles\. These may be broader than required\. Additional analysis is underway to determine whether smaller scoped built in roles will be adequate, or if “Custom Roles” are required\.

## <a id="_Toc203750153"></a>Procedures for Administrators

### Add a user to Entra

#### Adding a user without an SPLM ID

The user is “invited” to the SPLM Azure Tenant via Entra\. This should ONLY be done if the user is registering with an external email address \(e\.g\. @foofoo\.com\)\. __This is rarely done\.__

![](data:image/png;base64,)

#### Adding a user with an SPLM ID

To access Azure at all, the user’s Siemens GID must be associated in Entra with the user’s SPLM ID\.  If the user does not show up in [https://entra\.microsoft\.com](https://entra.microsoft.com), open a SNOW incident: [https://diswsiemens\.service\-now\.com/sp?id=sc\_cat\_item&sys\_id=af87b3e21b45c4100e21dc27bd4bcb11&sysparm\_category=c56fb20b1b1844106384a796bd4bcba3&catalog\_id=\-1](https://diswsiemens.service-now.com/sp?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=af87b3e21b45c4100e21dc27bd4bcb11&sysparm_category=c56fb20b1b1844106384a796bd4bcba3&catalog_id=-1) DISW: Report an Incident \. Ask the ticket to be forwarded to the DI SW Enterprise Foundation \([ad\_admins\.sisw@Siemens\.com](mailto:ad_admins.sisw@Siemens.com)\) team

### Add or remove a user to or from a group

Rather than grant roles to individuals, individuals are assigned to groups that have roles assigned to it\. The user thereafter can activate their membership in the group\.

Log in to [https://entra\.microsoft\.com](https://entra.microsoft.com), navigate to Identity Governance / PIM, select “Groups” under “Manage”, then select the group

![A screenshot of a computer

Description automatically generated](data:image/png;base64,)

Then click on “Manage” / “Assignments” and add or remove the user to the group as a member\.

__When adding, be sure__ to set the membership type to “Eligible”

### Create a group

Log in to [https://entra\.microsoft\.com](https://entra.microsoft.com) and activate the role DISWCreateGRP\_Subscription\_Owner 

\(This role can be requested via a [DISW SNOW ticket](https://diswsiemens.service-now.com/sp?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=af87b3e21b45c4100e21dc27bd4bcb11&sysparm_category=c56fb20b1b1844106384a796bd4bcba3&catalog_id=-1) and detail that this is for the SPLM tenant and that the ticket should be assigned to the [Azure Cloud Security \(DISW\-L2\)](https://diswsiemens.service-now.com/sys_user_group.do?sys_id=5bfac21597285910544cf4b3f153af6e) group\.\)

![A screenshot of a computer

Description automatically generated](data:image/png;base64,)

Navigate to “Groups” and click “New group”

![A screenshot of a computer

Description automatically generated](data:image/png;base64,)

Select Group Type = Security; input the group name and select owners\. Nominate 2 owners\.

![A screenshot of a computer

Description automatically generated](data:image/png;base64,)

Find the group in the list, select it, then enable Privileged Identity Management

![A screenshot of a computer

Description automatically generated](data:image/png;base64,)

### Assign roles to group

Navigate to the target resource in [https://portal\.azure\.com](https://portal.azure.com) \. The target resource may be a management group, subscription, resource group or a direct resource\. These instructions focus on the subscription\.  Navigate to Access control \(IAM\)\. Add a Role Assignment

![A screenshot of a computer

Description automatically generated](data:image/png;base64,)

Find the role you want and select it\. Then select the group:

![A white background with black and white clouds

Description automatically generated](data:image/png;base64,)

Make sure the assignment type and duration are correct\. __For ENTRA PIM GROUPS THE ASSIGNMENT SHOULD BE ACTIVE\. __This means the group has the role all the time, and users “activate” their membership of the group to automatically get all the roles assigned to the group\. \(This is allows *grouping* of roles rather than requiring a user to activate multiple roles\.\)

## <a id="_Toc203750154"></a>Access Reviews

Entra and Azure tool supported access reviews are __not possible __due to insufficient role assignments\. 

Access reviews are manual

1. Review each PIM group and members thereof

- Review each subscription, checking direct / non\-PIM access

Access reviews focus on __Privileged Administrator Roles__ only\.

### Access review steps

- In the Azure Portal, navigate to Subscription / Access Control \(IAM\), Role Assignments, Privileged administrator roles
- Select Scope: Subscription and Type: Group  

- Verify that for the groups, “State” is “Active Permanent” and End time is “Permanent”
- Verify that each group has the expected role assignment\. 
- Perform the following steps __for each group__
- Select Activity, Privileged Identity Management, Eligible Assignments  

- Verify that each user should continue being a member of the group\.
- Remove or update assignment as required\.
- Select “Active Assignments”  

- Verify that the listed users should continue being group owners\.
- In the subscription Access Control page, select Type: User  

- Verify users which have privileged role assignments\.
- Generally there should be none\.

## <a id="_Toc203750155"></a>Records

Azure and Entra maintain records of group creation\. All groups for the subscription begin with “TcX” and can be found via appropriate query\.

Access review records can be found in [ISMS Activity Records \(2025\)](https://mypolarion.industrysoftware.automation.siemens.com/polarion/#/project/Teamcenter/wiki/TcX%20Process%20and%20Security/ISMS%20Activity%20Records_2025)
